results.name: 1. fresh export: 13 pivot shapes are schema-valid, recomputed by pandas from the XML, survive openpyxl
2. 60 randomized pivots on random data (fresh export) — XSD + pandas oracle
3. unfaithful shapes are saved values-only with the reason; the package stays valid
4. lossless save: source edit + Refresh regenerates ours in place (same parts, same cacheId)
5. lossless save: deleting a pivot removes its parts / rels / overrides / <pivotCache>; a new one is added
6. POI workbooks with native PivotTables: native parts byte-identical, ours added with a new cacheId
7. a name colliding with a native PivotTable on the same sheet becomes "Name (2)"
8. a table re-pivoted outside the app is treated as native and never overwritten
9. a cache shared with another table is not rewritten: ours moves to its own cache
10. a part name that an existing relationship points at is never reused, even when that part is missing
